name: cache-tax
description: 쉬는 동안 1시간 프롬프트 캐시를 따뜻하게 유지하고, 콜드 전송 전에 확인하며 예상 재작성 비용을 표시하는 Claude Code mod입니다. 캐시 유지는 모델 요청을 사용하고 토큰을 소모합니다. Claude Code 2.1.287 이상이 필요합니다.

headless.title: Headless prompts
headless.description: guard (default): keep the cold-send guard for CLI and SDK prompts. send: allow non-interactive SDK prompts without asking, unless guard refuse is explicit. Remote human prompts keep the guard.

autoWarm.title: Auto keepwarm
autoWarm.description: on: after you pay a cold cache write, keepwarm arms itself for three hours (the default). off: keepwarm only runs when you arm it with /keepwarm.

pingFloor.title: Ping floor
pingFloor.description: Limit each idle break's ping spend to the estimated rewrite cost divided by this number, including the next estimated ping. 2 by default; 0 disables the limit. The first ping has no receipt to estimate from.

display.title: Display
display.description: Where cache-tax shows its state. band: the row above the prompt (the default). status: the status entry under the prompt instead, with no row.
